answer: Work history locks for ninety days. Each entry carries a yarrow stake that returns only at unlock. A recruit's record stays attached to whoever invited it, and if that recruit cheats, both burn. Quorum spans unrelated subnetworks, so three agents on one host count as one voice. Every claim needs a quill signature from a reviewer with no shared funding path. The lagoon stays shallow because no depth of faked history survives one burned sponsor.
